what: D191: where the trunk's backward error GROWS between padded width 64 and 384.

hosts.floor_and_local_float64_reference_built_: qb1 (tt-quietbox), CPU only, no card, EPYC 8124P, torch 2.8.0+cpu / python 3.10.12

REF_WIDTH_INVARIANCE.what: upstream 0.4.3 float64 at width 384 against the same at width 64, per tensor
REF_WIDTH_INVARIANCE.why: the denominator of every figure below. If it moved, a difference of numerators would not be a difference of absolute errors.

CLOSURE.why: the decomposition is exact or it is not a decomposition

FLOOR_GROWTH.what: upstream's own bf16 recipe measured the same way. The control for 'is any of this width response a property of the comparison rather than of our arm'.

MATCHED.floor_host: qb1 (tt-quietbox), CPU only, no card, EPYC 8124P, torch 2.8.0+cpu / python 3.10.12

GROWTH.units: mw^2, i.e. sum_t ||ours_t - ref_t||^2 / ||g_ref||^2. Additive by construction.

SOFTMAX.what: of3t-apbback's softmax result is scoped to 16 tensors of ONE block. This asks how much of the trunk's width growth lives inside that scope. No device run: this row holds no card and the bisect cannot be re-taken at a second width.

WIDTH_DELTA_OF_OUR_OWN_ARM.what: ours(384) - ours(64), per tensor. The reference is width-invariant, so this is the whole width effect with no reference in it.
